servinfo.title: Brake Stroke Sensor Removal and Installation

attention4.ptxt: Failure to take proper precautions when handling the brake stroke sensor may lead to malfunction of the sensor.

item.ptxt: Do not drop or otherwise expose the sensor to large shock. Any brake stroke sensor that has received large shock must be replaced.
Keep the sensor section of the brake stroke sensor away from water and/or oil.

s1.ptxt: Remove brake stroke sensor (1) from brake pedal assembly (2).

attention3.ptxt: Do not break the pin (1) that holds the lever (2) in place before tightening the brake stroke sensor bolts (3). If the pin is broken by mistake, follow the installation procedure for a reused part to install the brake stroke sensor (4).

s1.ptxt: Insert lever of brake stroke sensor into opening (5) in brake pedal (6).
Install brake stroke sensor and tighten brake stroke sensor bolts to specified torque.
Break the pin that holds lever by depressing brake pedal.
Check that pin comes off lever and that brake pedal can be operated smoothly.
Perform Brake Stroke Sensor Zero Point Reset .

ptxt.intxrefpoff: Brake Stroke Sensor Inspection and Adjustment

s1.ptxt: Insert lever (1) of brake stroke sensor (2) into opening (3) in brake pedal (4).
Install brake stroke sensor and tighten brake stroke sensor bolts (5) temporarily.
Adjust installation position of brake stroke sensor referring to “Adjustment” under Brake Stroke Sensor Inspection and Adjustment .
